facts.text: The hotel is located in the Warehouse District of New Orleans.
facts.excerpt: Virgin Hotels New Orleans is located in the lively Warehouse District with a stunning rooftop pool overlooking the city

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop pool with views across the city.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy access to our beautiful rooftop pool with views across the city for the perfect way to unwind.

facts.text: The French Quarter and Garden District are minutes away by car.
facts.excerpt: A little further afield, just minutes away by car, you’ll find the famous French Quarter and Garden District.

facts.text: In the Warehouse District, restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques and BBQ joints occupy converted brick warehouses, and museums and art galleries dot every street.
facts.excerpt: Here, innovative restaurants, sleek coffee shops, eclectic boutiques, top colleges and BBQ joints can be found in converted brick warehouses, and museums and art galleries dot every street.

facts.text: Chambers use a two-chamber design, with discreet partitions separating the sleeping quarters from the dressing room.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy your privacy with discreet partitions separating the sleeping quarters from the dressing room.

facts.text: Rooms have a dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area with flattering lights.
facts.excerpt: take a seat at our dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area. Fitted with flattering lights

facts.text: In-room SMEG fridges are stocked at street prices.
facts.excerpt: Our signature SMEG fridges are smartly stocked at street prices, so you won't be paying a premium for the convenience.

facts.text: Suites offer views of the French Quarter from the balcony.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the views of the French Quarter from your balcony or hang out in your stylish living space.

facts.text: Rooms with a balcony are available.
facts.excerpt: Our rooms with a balcony offer breathtaking views, perfect for relaxing and watching the world go by.

facts.text: Wi-Fi is free with no hidden charges.
facts.excerpt: All the Wi-Fi, all the time. Watch, play, call or scroll to your heart's content. With no hidden charges.

facts.text: The Virgin Hotels App lets guests order room service, adjust temperature, control lights and TV, or access their chamber.
facts.excerpt: Order room service, adjust the temperature, control the lights and TV or access your chamber.

facts.text: Dogs of all sizes and breeds are welcome.
facts.excerpt: All sizes and breeds are welcome.

facts.text: The hotel is ADA accessible, with rooms featuring roll-in showers, tubs with grab bars, wider entrances and lowered countertops.
facts.excerpt: Virgin Hotels New Orleans is proudly ADA accessible, offering rooms that feature roll-in accessible showers, tubs with grab bars, wider entrances as well as lowered countertops and amenities.

facts.text: The Pool Club is a rooftop pool bar with a wrap-around lounge deck and full bar.
facts.excerpt: Take it easy at our rooftop pool complete with a wrap-around lounge deck and full bar.

facts.text: Commons Club offers a fresh perspective on classic New Orleans recipes.
facts.excerpt: With a fresh perspective on classic New Orleans recipes prepared with bold flavors and innovative techniques, each plate is designed to impress.

facts.text: Funny Library is the hotel's coffee shop, serving pastries, brews, juices and nibbles.
facts.excerpt: Lounge, linger and LOL in our coffee shop in New Orleans Downtown. With pastries, brews, juices and nibbles

facts.text: The hotel has a 24-hour gym.
facts.excerpt: choose to break a sweat any time of day in our 24 hour hotel gym at Virgin Hotels New Orleans

facts.text: The hotel hosts live music events and entertainment.
facts.excerpt: get amped for our live music events and entertainment.

facts.text: Dreamboat is an intimate venue for weddings, receptions and meetings.
facts.excerpt: A modern, intimate wedding venue, event venue, and party venue all wrapped up in one creating an unforgettable backdrop for New Orleans weddings, receptions, and meetings.

facts.text: Voted #3 Best Hotel in New Orleans by Travel + Leisure's World's Best Awards 2026.
facts.excerpt: Voted #3 Best Hotel in New Orleans by Travel + Leisure's World's Best Awards 2026

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a couples and family-friendly luxury lifestyle hotel.
facts.excerpt: our couples and family-friendly luxury lifestyle hotel in New Orleans

facts.text: The page places the rooftop pool bar in the French Quarter, while the home page puts the hotel in the Warehouse District.
facts.excerpt: Take it easy at our rooftop pool and bar in the French Quarter

contradictions.note: p3 says the rooftop pool and bar is 'in the French Quarter'; p1 says the hotel is in the Warehouse District and the French Quarter is minutes away by car

sources.excerpt: Take it easy at our rooftop pool and bar in the French Quarter
A little further afield, just minutes away by car, you’ll find the famous French Quarter and Garden District.
